unit: EU farms workers data and technology providers
evidence: OECD describes robotics as a response to labor shortages and identifies farm diversity data ownership and farmer control as issues
last_unobserved_stage: reliable benefits worker outcomes and food resilience
conversion_question: Can agricultural AI create value without transferring control away from farmers?

unit: US crop farms by size and technology
evidence: USDA ERS reports 52 percent midsize and 70 percent large farms used guidance or autosteering in 2023 while small farms had the lowest adoption
last_unobserved_stage: causality affordability smallholder pathways and equitable benefit
conversion_question: Can automation reach smaller farms without imposing unsustainable capital costs?

unit: Europe and Central Asia smallholder farmers and service providers
evidence: FAO reports very low use and identifies cost skills support connectivity electricity and payback barriers
last_unobserved_stage: durable income yield resilience and inclusion
conversion_question: Can drone services become reachable and repeatable for small-scale producers?

unit: Bangladesh small-scale producers organizations and Farmer Field Schools
evidence: FAO documents a producer-organization and field-school initiative to tailor sustainable mechanization to smallholders
last_unobserved_stage: scale uptime cost recovery gender effects and farm outcomes
conversion_question: Can collective learning and ownership turn mechanization into local capability?

unit: US dairy farms by herd size and labor type
evidence: USDA ERS finds robotic milking labor-cost effects differ by farm size and paid versus unpaid labor
last_unobserved_stage: household welfare worker quality payback animal welfare and replication
conversion_question: Does farm automation improve livelihoods or merely reallocate paid and unpaid work?

unit: US processing tomato and apple operations growers workers and extension
evidence: USDA NIFA reports inspection and picking performance plus a workshop-linked case of estimated labor savings and grower adoption
last_unobserved_stage: long-term employment transition safety total cost and resilience
conversion_question: Can automation reduce hazardous work while improving worker agency and farm viability?

unit: EU farmers AI systems and machinery
evidence: OECD reports incipient adoption, continued operator supervision and demand for clear economic payback
last_unobserved_stage: full autonomy reliable returns repair capacity and control
conversion_question: What human skills and accountability remain necessary as autonomy increases?

unit: large greenhouse growers high-value crops and robot providers
evidence: FAO describes a greenhouse robot targeted at large farms and designed for labor-intensive plant handling
last_unobserved_stage: service models cooperative access and smallholder benefit
conversion_question: Can high-value automation be converted into shared rural access rather than concentration?
